name: FUJIAN SANFAN Sports Products Co., Ltd.
description: FUJIAN SANFAN is a 12-year OEM/ODM manufacturer of yoga mats and fitness equipment based in Jinjiang, Fujian, China. TPE yoga mats from 100 pcs MOQ, foam rollers from 500 pcs, physical samples with your own logo and packaging in 7 days, and full customization of material, size, thickness, color, double-color, logo, fold and packaging. REACH, CA Prop 65 and 6P/7P compliant, ISO 9001 and BSCI audited, exporting worldwide with FOB, EXW, CIF or DDP terms.
